notes: all choices on monitor_train only; validation for reporting; no test split

arm count: ball r+2 around the rounded refined position, 26-connectivity, component of the candidate (or nearest mask voxel within 2 voxels), components in the shell r < d <= r+2, capped at 3; off-vessel = 0 group
candidate types use the one-to-one 2 mm matching of ALL candidates >= 0.05 (diagnostic); false detections of a rule use the matching of its kept candidates (part-2 detail2_patch)
rules a/b: exhaustive 2-D grid (shared, own) per (tau, r), best (tau, r) chosen separately per rule

stage2.change: Stage-1 flip8 5^3 candidates kept by the rule (thresholds chosen in analyse3) replace D.peaks inside the unchanged T.predict of the stage-2 run (as part 2 stage2v2); stage 2 keeps its own features and centreline map; edge threshold re-selected on monitor_train by edge F1 (D.select_edge_threshold); evaluation D.evaluate; per-patch counts compare_dense_anchored.dense_patch + Betti; paired = protocol_report_20261106.paired (subject bootstrap).
